## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Sabbapariññā Sutta* (Iti 7; PTS It 3), translated as *Complete Understanding of All*, is the seventh discourse of the *Itivuttaka*. The text teaches that an individual becomes capable of putting an end to suffering when the mind, purified of passion for the "All" (*sabba*), completely abandons it.
